company_profile.name: Agro-Industrial del Este S.A. (AIDESA)
company_profile.industry: Agro-Industrial Crushing, Grain Trading & Maquila Export

critical_workflows.name: Hidrovía Fluvial Grain Barge Export
critical_workflows.description: Crushed high-protein soybean meal pellets loaded at Villeta port into 16-barge push-convoys traveling down the Paraguay-Paraná river to Rosario/San Lorenzo ports.

critical_workflows.name: Cross-Border Terrestrial Trucking to Brazil via CDE
critical_workflows.description: Double-trailer bitren trucks carrying grain or packaged expeller products across the Friendship Bridge (Puente de la Amistad) to Paraná state feed mills.

critical_workflows.name: Inbound Raw Soybean Procurement & Grain Scale Intake
critical_workflows.description: Grain intake from 80 regional farmers across Alto Paraná and Itapúa, weighed and sampled at facility báscula fiscal.

known_bottlenecks.title: Hydrological River Draft Restrictions at Critical Passes
known_bottlenecks.description: Severe shallow-water alerts at Paso Queso (km 1590) force convoy halts or expensive cargo offloading (alijo) when permissible draft drops below 9.5 feet.
known_bottlenecks.primary_cause: Manual, delayed extraction of Prefectura Naval hydrometric bulletins; pilot notification lag of 6+ hours.

known_bottlenecks.title: Cross-Border Transit Document Discrepancy & Customs Dwell
known_bottlenecks.description: Mismatches between SAP export invoices, packing lists, and DNIT VUE transit permits (MIC/DTA) stall trucks in fiscal parking at Ciudad del Este for up to 36 hours.
known_bottlenecks.primary_cause: Double data entry across ERP and customs broker portals; weekend unattended approval holds.

known_bottlenecks.title: Grain Intake Moisture and Quality Assay Dispute Resolution
known_bottlenecks.description: Discrepancies in moisture assays (>14% max threshold) cause line blockages at the báscula fiscal and retrospective commercial penalty disputes with producers.
known_bottlenecks.primary_cause: Manual calculation of CAPPRO standard discount tables across silo operators.

key_decisions.title: Charter Emergency Alijo Shallow-Draft Barge vs Hold Convoy
key_decisions.frequency: During low river level periods (15-20 times/year)
key_decisions.consequence_of_delay: Demurrage fines of $6,400/day per push-boat plus ocean-vessel missed laycan in San Lorenzo.

key_decisions.title: Authorize Emergency Customs Broker Fee & Re-filing
key_decisions.consequence_of_delay: Detention charges of $150/truck/day and driver border stranding.

data_sources.name: Export Operations Google Drive
data_sources.format: PDFs (Bills of Lading, CRTs, SENAVE Phytosanitary Certificates)

constraints.security: Export customer pricing and supplier banking credentials must remain within client Google Cloud / SQLite boundary.
constraints.compliance: DNIT and SENAVE regulatory submissions legally mandate certified human customs broker approval.
constraints.budget_tier: Enterprise FDE Pilot Scope ($30,000-$60,000 implementation ceiling).
constraints.integration: Google Workspace already deployed across all 250 staff; SAP B1 read-only replica available.
constraints.change_management: Dispatchers and barge captains rely on simple WhatsApp summaries and Google Sheets dashboards.
